SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.PLAN_MONTH AS PLAN_MONTH, A.SEQ AS SEQ, A.PLAN_GBN AS PLAN_GBN, A.PLAN_ST_YEAR AS PLAN_ST_YEAR, A.PLAN_END_YEAR AS PLAN_END_YEAR, A.PLAN_USER AS PLAN_USER, A.CLOSE_YN AS CLOSE_YN, CASE WHEN CLOSE_YN = '1' THEN '마감' ELSE ' ' END AS CLOSE_NANE, A. READY_AMT AS READY_AMT FROM dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_BASIC A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.PLAN_MONTH) DESC

SELECT A.CODE AS CODE, NULL AS SUB_CODE, NULL AS KIND_CODE, A.CODE AS CD, A.CODE_NAME AS CODE_NAME, A.REMARKS AS REMARKS, A.SEQ AS SEQ, '1' AS LEVEL, A.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_1, 0 AS OR_2, 0 AS OR_3, NULL AS REGUL_YN, NULL AS ALL_PERIOD, NULL AS SUB_PERIOD, NULL AS SUB_RATE, NULL AS END_YEAR FROM TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_CODE A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.PLAN_MONTH = #{PLAN_MONTH} AND A.SEQ = #{SEQ} UNION ALL SELECT B.CODE AS CODE, B.SUB_CODE AS SUB_CODE, NULL AS KIND_CODE, B.SUB_CODE AS CD, B.SUB_CODE_NAME AS CODE_NAME, B.REMARKS AS REMARKS, B.SEQ AS SEQ, '2' AS LEVEL, A.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_1, B.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_2, 0 AS OR_3, NULL AS REGUL_YN, NULL AS ALL_PERIOD, NULL AS SUB_PERIOD, NULL AS SUB_RATE, NULL AS END_YEAR FROM TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_SUBCODE B INNER JOIN TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_CODE A ON A.CODE = B.CODE AND A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = B.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ WHERE B.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND B.PLAN_MONTH = #{PLAN_MONTH} AND B.SEQ = #{SEQ} UNION ALL SELECT C.CODE AS CODE, C.SUB_CODE AS SUB_CODE, C.KIND_CODE AS KIND_CODE, C.KIND_CODE AS CD, C.KIND_NAME AS CODE_NAME, C.REMARKS AS REMARKS, C.SEQ AS SEQ, '3' AS LEVEL, A.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_1, B.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_2, C.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_3, C.REGUL_YN AS REGUL_YN, C.ALL_PERIOD AS ALL_PERIOD, C.SUB_PERIOD AS SUB_PERIOD, C.SUB_RATE AS SUB_RATE, C.END_YEAR AS END_YEAR FROM TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_KIND C INNER JOIN TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_SUBCODE B ON B.CODE = C.CODE AND B.SUB_CODE = C.SUB_CODE AND B.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND B.PLAN_MONTH = C.PLAN_MONTH AND B.SEQ = C.SEQ INNER JOIN TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_CODE A ON A.CODE = C.CODE AND A.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = C.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = C.SEQ WHERE C.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND C.PLAN_MONTH = #{PLAN_MONTH} AND C.SEQ = #{SEQ} ORDER BY OR_1, OR_2, OR_3, LEVEL

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.PLAN_MONTH AS PLAN_MONTH, A.SEQ AS SEQ, COUNT(DISTINCT B.CODE) AS CODE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT C.SUB_CODE) AS SUB_CODE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT D.KIND_CODE) AS KIND_CODE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT E.ITEM_CODE) AS ITEM_CODE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT F.ITEM_CODE) AS ITEM_UNIT_CNT FROM dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_BASIC A LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_CODE B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = B.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_SUBCODE C ON A.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = C.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = C.SEQ AND B.CODE = C.CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_KIND D ON A.OFFICE_CODE = D.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = D.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = D.SEQ AND B.CODE = D.CODE AND C.SUB_CODE = D.SUB_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_ITEM E ON A.OFFICE_CODE = E.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = E.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = E.SEQ AND B.CODE = E.CODE AND C.SUB_CODE = E.SUB_CODE AND D.KIND_CODE = E.KIND_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_ITEM_UNIT F ON A.OFFICE_CODE = F.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = F.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = F.SEQ AND B.CODE = F.CODE AND C.SUB_CODE = F.SUB_CODE AND D.KIND_CODE = F.KIND_CODE AND E.ITEM_CODE = F.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.PLAN_MONTH = #{PLAN_MONTH} GROUP BY A.OFFICE_CODE, A.PLAN_MONTH, A.SEQ;

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.PLAN_MONTH AS PLAN_MONTH, A.SEQ AS SEQ, COUNT(DISTINCT B.CODE) AS CODE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT C.SUB_CODE) AS SUB_CODE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT D.KIND_CODE) AS KIND_CODE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT E.ITEM_CODE) AS ITEM_CODE_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT F.ITEM_CODE) AS ITEM_UNIT_CNT FROM dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_BASIC A LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_CODE B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = B.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_SUBCODE C ON A.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = C.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = C.SEQ AND B.CODE = C.CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_KIND D ON A.OFFICE_CODE = D.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = D.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = D.SEQ AND B.CODE = D.CODE AND C.SUB_CODE = D.SUB_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_ITEM E ON A.OFFICE_CODE = E.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = E.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = E.SEQ AND B.CODE = E.CODE AND C.SUB_CODE = E.SUB_CODE AND D.KIND_CODE = E.KIND_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_ITEM_UNIT F ON A.OFFICE_CODE = F.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = F.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = F.SEQ AND B.CODE = F.CODE AND C.SUB_CODE = F.SUB_CODE AND D.KIND_CODE = F.KIND_CODE AND E.ITEM_CODE = F.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.PLAN_MONTH = #{PLAN_MONTH} GROUP BY A.OFFICE_CODE, A.PLAN_MONTH, A.SEQ;

mapper.select: SELECT A.CODE AS CODE, NULL AS SUB_CODE, NULL AS KIND_CODE, A.CODE AS CD, A.CODE_NAME AS CODE_NAME, A.REMARKS AS REMARKS, A.SEQ AS SEQ, '1' AS LEVEL, A.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_1, 0 AS OR_2, 0 AS OR_3, NULL AS REGUL_YN, NULL AS ALL_PERIOD, NULL AS SUB_PERIOD, NULL AS SUB_RATE FROM dbo.TRP_REPAIR_CODE A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} A.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT B.CODE AS CODE, B.SUB_CODE AS SUB_CODE, NULL AS KIND_CODE, B.SUB_CODE AS CD, B.CODE AS UP_CD, B.SUB_CODE_NAME AS CODE_NAME, B.REMARKS AS REMARKS, B.SEQ AS SEQ, '2' AS LEVEL, A.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_1, B.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_2, 0 AS OR_3, NULL AS REGUL_YN, NULL AS ALL_PERIOD, NULL AS SUB_PERIOD, NULL AS SUB_RATE FROM dbo.TRP_REPAIR_SUBCODE B INNER JOIN TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_CODE A ON A.CODE = B.CODE AND A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = B.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ WHERE B.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT C.CODE AS CODE, C.SUB_CODE AS SUB_CODE, C.KIND_CODE AS KIND_CODE, C.KIND_CODE AS CD, C.SUB_CODE AS UP_CD, C.KIND_NAME AS CODE_NAME, C.REMARKS AS REMARKS, C.SEQ AS SEQ, '3' AS LEVEL, A.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_1, B.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_2, C.ORDER_SEQ AS OR_3, C.REGUL_YN AS REGUL_YN, C.ALL_PERIOD AS ALL_PERIOD, C.SUB_PERIOD AS SUB_PERIOD, C.SUB_RATE AS SUB_RATE FROM dbo.TRP_REPAIR_KIND C INNER JOIN TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_SUBCODE B ON B.CODE = C.CODE AND B.SUB_CODE = C.SUB_CODE AND B.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND B.PLAN_MONTH = C.PLAN_MONTH AND B.SEQ = C.SEQ INNER JOIN TRP_MONTH_REPAIR_CODE A ON A.CODE = C.CODE AND A.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND A.PLAN_MONTH = C.PLAN_MONTH AND A.SEQ = C.SEQ WHERE C.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGIN_OFFICE_CODE} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY OR_1, OR_2, OR_3, LEVEL
